title: Material position, identity and candidate choice: a measured bridge
reservation: Check local run registry before reserving LH271. Never overwrite a numbered run.
research_question: How do reported financial deterioration, directly reported identity importance and perceived candidate responsiveness relate to reported candidate choice? Which causal mechanism distinctions remain unidentified?

primary_data.sample: combined fresh in-person and fresh web samples, excluding panel and PAPI; verify with the official sample variables and weights
primary_data.target: Explicit observed-response domain within the selected fresh sample, not automatically all voters or all citizens
primary_data.outcome: reported 2024 presidential vote, D/R domain; other votes, nonparticipation and unknown retained in separate denominator accounting

inherited_artifacts.LH262: selection and denominator accounting, fixed vs current groups
inherited_artifacts.LH263_LH266: identification sets, measurement assumptions, observational equivalence
inherited_artifacts.LH267_LH269: proper scoring, guarded claims, independent tests, frozen baseline and erratum
inherited_artifacts.LH270: vote/nonparticipation/unknown distinctions; provisional report only, not a validated empirical control

known_timing_limit: Key ANES national/racial identity importance and subjective class items are POST election; they are barred from pre-election prediction and causal exposure claims.

hypotheses.label: identity trade-off
hypotheses.needs: independent measurements of perceived material advantage, delivery credibility, identity affinity, and choice

hypotheses.label: identity-conditioned beliefs or credibility
hypotheses.needs: separate belief and credibility measures or a suitable experimental design

hypotheses.label: material-identity complementarity
hypotheses.needs: direct identity-importance item, reported economic condition and actual reported vote; observed interaction is not causal complementarity

hypotheses.label: participation/composition
hypotheses.needs: nonvoters and unknown turnout preserved; not a residual explanation for conditional vote choice

primary_variables.Y: V242096x, code 2=R and 1=D after independent mapping checks; never use nonvoter preferences as votes
primary_variables.E: V241451, codes 4/5=reported worsening, 1/2/3=not worsening; negative codes remain unknown
primary_variables.I: V242536, codes 1/2=high reported national-identity importance, 3/4/5=lower; POST associational use only
primary_variables.C: relative ordering of V241201 vs V241206 candidate responsiveness ratings; R higher / tie / D higher; no equal-interval subtraction
primary_variables.X: pre-election PID, household-income category, home tenure, age and sample/mode indicators if verified; maximum 12 nuisance degrees of freedom fixed before joint outcomes are opened

models.purpose: add separately measured identity importance and perceived responsiveness

models.formula: Y ~ E + X + I + C + E:I
models.purpose: one prespecified interaction; same response domain as M0/M1

primary_estimand: common-support standardized difference in the E-versus-Y association between high and lower I; descriptive probability-scale contrast, not a treatment effect
secondary_analyses: raw and correctly weighted domain counts; limited White/Black response summaries only where question universes are compatible; no subgroup model search
subgroup_rules: Race membership is not identity importance. Employment, education, income and self-ascribed class are distinct constructs.
Do not create mutually exclusive categories from multiple race selections without a documented rule.
Race-specific identity responses need not have cross-group measurement equivalence.
Do not estimate separate subgroup interactions in this run.
fit_gates: Source version, actual column presence, response order, negative missing codes, universes and temporal role verified.
PRE label alone does not prove interview preceded an early ballot; preserve actual timing limitations.
Same observed-response domain for M0/M1/M2, with full frame and exclusion reasons retained.
Use documented weight/PSU/strata and survey-domain variance procedures; do not drop the entire design frame before subpopulation estimation.
Each primary E x I cell has at least 10 observed D and 10 observed R votes: a safety screen, not a precision theorem.
No separation, no unsupported extrapolation across E/I/covariate support, design rank and degrees of freedom checked.
A trusted survey-statistics library is available and its installed version recorded; do not handwrite survey variance to force completion.
gate_failure_output: deliver verified measurement manifest, denominator tables and identification limits; no substitute proxy, no extra state, no unreported revised sample
missing_data: negative/unknown values remain distinct; tables include nonresponse. Complete-response association does not recover unobserved respondents. No automatic MAR claim or inverse-response correction.
comparison_policy: No LH269 prediction promotion, no p-value ranking of mechanisms, no coefficient-size ratio called culture versus class importance.
political_scope: observational academic research, no campaign targeting or tailored persuasion
Mamdani: motivation/context card only; no inference about his electorate from national ANES coefficients and no new NYC fieldwork in this run
stop: One measurement audit, one fixed set of tables, at most three gated associative fits, one independently checked report. No iterative significance hunting or replacement prediction algorithm.
common_support_rule: 固定S为共同完整应答域中，每个C×PID×income×owner×age×sample×phone组合均有四种E×I取值的记录；任一所需组合为空时不外推。模型仍用相同完整应答域。S为空则不拟合；报告S覆盖。
variance_scope: survey包域估计；如支持拟合，概率差的区间条件于固定经验标准化S分布，不宣称含目标分布估计不确定性。
